/seasonalVariations/0/description.source_en: The ice wall starts to form once the valley water freezes hard. Early in the season it is smaller and the village may still be building it up. Seoraksan usually has its first settled snow.

/seasonalVariations/1/description.source_en: The strongest month by a clear margin. The ice wall is at full height, Seoraksan's snow cover is most reliable, and Nami's tree avenues are properly frosted. Coldest temperatures of the year — dress accordingly.

/seasonalVariations/2/description.source_en: Still dependable in most years, and marginally longer daylight at the Eobi stop. Watch for warm spells, which shrink the wall quickly.

/seasonalVariations/3/description.source_en: The tour does not run. The ice wall is gone by late February and Eobi returns to being a summer swimming valley. For Seoraksan and Nami outside winter, see our Seoraksan + Nami Island + ⟦G0⟧ day tour.
